title: Training Notes on Mobility Equipment — Useful Lifetime and Replacement of an Owned Chair
content:
# Useful Lifetime and Replacement — Mobility Equipment

**The rule.** An owned Mobility Equipment chair is replaced for age only when the useful lifetime has elapsed: an age-based replacement is ordered no earlier than the class's reasonable useful lifetime, in months, after the chair is delivered, counting calendar months from the delivery date with month-end fallback to the last day of a shorter month and the boundary day included. Before then a chair is replaced only for loss or theft (with a police, fire or insurance report where the class requires one), irreparable damage, a repair costlier than replacement, or a documented change in medical condition where the class allows replacement for a change in condition. The replacement opens a new wheelchair record with its own qualification and rental period; the old record moves to replaced.

## The age clock

- **Starts from:** the delivery date on the system's wheelchair record of this chair.
- **Counting:** calendar months; where the target month is shorter, the last day of that month.
- **Comparison:** the order is no earlier than the date reached; that date itself qualifies.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 60-month lifetime)

| Delivery date | Date the lifetime is reached | Age-based order on | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2020 | 31 August 2025 | 31 August 2025 | qualifies — the boundary day is included |
| 31 August 2020 | 31 August 2025 | 30 August 2025 | too early for an age-based replacement |
| 29 February 2020 | 28 February 2025 (month-end fallback) | 28 February 2025 | qualifies |

## Grounds before the lifetime ends

- loss or theft, with a police, fire or insurance report where the class requires one;
- irreparable damage;
- a repair costlier than replacement;
- a documented change in medical condition, where the class allows it.

## What a replacement does

A new wheelchair record is opened, with its own qualification and its own rental period; the old record moves to replaced.
